## Data acquisition

Equipment that records neural, physiological, behavioral or environmental signals and images, from amplifiers, cameras and sensors to complete recording rigs and imaging scanners.

### Amplifier

An amplifier unit installed in a setup that amplifies and filters electrophysiological signals before digitization. A recording station tracked as one unit is an Ephys rig.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Camera

A camera installed in a setup for video recording of behavior or for image acquisition, for example on a microscope.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Data acquisition system

A data acquisition system installed in a setup that digitizes and records analog and digital signals, such as a DAQ board or a multichannel recording system.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Electroencephalography system (EEG)

An EEG system installed in a setup for recording electrical brain activity from scalp or skull-surface electrodes.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Electromyography machine

An EMG system installed in a setup for recording the electrical activity of muscles.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Ephys rig

An integrated electrophysiology rig, such as a patch-clamp or extracellular recording station, documented as a single unit in a setup. Choose it when the rig is tracked as a whole rather than as separate amplifiers, manipulators and acquisition hardware.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Fiber photometry system

A fiber photometry system installed in a setup that delivers excitation light through an implanted optical fiber and records fluorescence from genetically encoded indicators.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Force plate

A force plate installed in a setup that measures ground reaction forces, for example to quantify gait, posture or startle responses.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Humidity sensor

A sensor installed in a setup that measures relative humidity to monitor experimental or housing conditions. Hardware that regulates humidity is a Humidity controller.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Light sensor

A sensor installed in a setup that measures light intensity or optical power, such as an ambient light sensor or optical power meter.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

An MRI scanner used for structural or functional imaging of subjects.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Ophys rig

An integrated optical physiology rig, such as an imaging station combining microscope, light sources and acquisition hardware, documented as a single unit in a setup. Choose it when the rig is tracked as a whole rather than as separate components.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

## Behavioral and stimulation tools

Equipment that delivers sensory, optical or electrical stimuli to subjects or supports behavioral tasks and locomotion.

### Behavior rig

An integrated behavioral apparatus in a setup, such as an operant chamber, maze or head-fixed task station, documented as a single unit. Choose it when the rig is tracked as a whole rather than as separate components.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Floating air platform

An air-lifted platform or homecage in a setup that floats on air so a head-fixed animal can move it as it walks, for locomotion and navigation under head fixation. Vibration isolation tables are Anti-vibration tables.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Iontophoresis stimulator

A current source in a setup used for iontophoretic application of drugs or tracers through a micropipette.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Laser

A laser installed in a setup, used for example for optogenetic stimulation, photostimulation or as an imaging light source.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### LED driver

A driver that powers and modulates LEDs in a setup, for example to generate light pulses for optogenetic stimulation.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Light emitter

An LED or other non-laser light source in a setup, used for example for optogenetic stimulation, visual stimulation or illumination. A laser source is a Laser.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Running wheel

A running wheel in a setup on which a subject runs, often with an encoder to measure locomotion.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Speaker

A speaker in a setup used to deliver auditory stimuli, such as tones, noise or ultrasonic sounds. Recording sound is a Microphone.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Stimulation device

A stimulator in a setup, such as an electrical stimulus generator or stimulus isolator, that delivers stimuli to a subject or tissue. Use it for stimulation hardware that no more specific equipment type describes.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Treadmill

A treadmill in a setup on which a subject walks or runs, either motorized or freely driven, often head-fixed.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

## Environmental controllers

Equipment that controls or isolates the experimental environment, such as temperature, humidity, vibration and acoustic noise.

### Anti-vibration table

An anti-vibration (optical) table that supports a setup and isolates it from floor vibrations, as used for electrophysiology, imaging and optics.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Humidity controller

A device that regulates humidity in a setup, housing area or recording enclosure. A sensor that only measures humidity is a Humidity sensor.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Noise isolation chamber

A sound-attenuating chamber that shields a setup from external acoustic noise and, often, light and electrical interference.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Thermal controller

A temperature controller, such as a heating pad with feedback control or a bath heater, that maintains the subject's or preparation's temperature. A sensor that only measures temperature is a Temperature sensor.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

## Surgical equipment

Equipment used during surgery and other invasive procedures, including anesthesia, stereotaxic positioning, injection, perfusion and drilling.

### Anesthesia system

An anesthesia system in a setup, such as an isoflurane vaporizer with induction chamber and nose cone, used to induce and maintain anesthesia during surgery or experiments.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode, SurgicalDisposable.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Injection system

An injection system, such as a nanoliter injector or microsyringe pump, used to deliver viral vectors, tracers or drugs into tissue during surgery.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode, SurgicalDisposable.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Micromanipulator

A micromanipulator that positions electrodes, pipettes or optical fibers with micrometer precision, mounted on a stereotaxic frame or recording rig.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode, SurgicalDisposable.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Perfusion system

A perfusion system that delivers fluids through tissue or a preparation, for example for transcardial perfusion or slice superfusion.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode, SurgicalDisposable.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Stereotaxic frame

A stereotaxic frame that holds the subject's head in a fixed coordinate system for targeting brain regions during surgery or acute experiments.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

### Surgical power tool

A powered surgical tool, such as a dental drill, used for craniotomies and other surgical procedures.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

Consumable types that can be selected: OpticFiberDesign, SiliconProbeDesign, EcogArrayDesign, VirusConstruct, SingleWireElectrode, SurgicalDisposable.

Coordinate systems offered for this type: External XYZ Coordinates with Euler Orientation; External XYZ Coordinates with Quaternion Orientation.

## Miscellaneous

A desktop or workstation computer in a setup that runs acquisition, stimulus-control or analysis software. Small embedded boards are documented as single-board computers or microcontrollers instead.

## Other types

### Drug Delivery System

A system in a setup that administers drugs or other compounds to a subject, for example an infusion pump or a cannula-based delivery system.

### One-Photon Microscope

A one-photon (single-photon excitation) microscope, such as a widefield fluorescence system, used for imaging in a setup. Records the specific unit and its configuration in that setup.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

### Pressure Sensor

A sensor installed in a setup that measures pressure, for example respiration, air puffs or fluid-line pressure.

{: .note }
> Legacy type: kept for existing records, not offered for new ones.

### Three-Photon Microscopy

A three-photon microscope used for deep-tissue imaging in a setup. Records the specific unit and its configuration in that setup.

### Two-Photon Microscopy
